text.style: fill: #3d3733; opacity: 0.78; font: 10px 'ABC Oracle Edu'

g.text: Lines: arriving (blue) and leaving (orange), thousands/year. Light bars (right axis): NET migration each year.

text.style: fill: #3d3733; opacity: 0.78; font: 10px 'ABC Oracle Edu'

g.text: The West (bottom right) flipped from +49K net in 2014 to roughly -200K post-COVID — the mirror of the Midwest.
